messages:
maria: Heads-up — Linda at ClearBank pushed again on tenant-scoped audit exports + searchability. They need export + query API for regulatory eDiscovery.

sam: quick q: export vs in-place query? We can do S3 export today, but search across >90d requires indexing across shards.

ana: proposed triage: 1) Immediate: presigned S3 export of audit bundle per-tenant + retention controls in console. 2) Short-term: searchable audit API (paginated, time-range + user filter) backed by indexed ES. 3) BYOK: allow customer-managed keys for audit bucket / at-rest encryption. 4) SOC2 evidence automation.

kevin: security notes — BYOK for logs = KMS + key import + rotation policy + HSM integration. Also need proof for logs immutability and integrity (signing?).

maria: customer asks SLA on export latency: they expect <5min for on-demand exports up to 50GB. realistic?

sam: estimate: presigned export pipeline end-to-end ~2 sprints; indexing + search ~3-4 sprints; BYOK for hosted infra ~4 sprints (complex). Latency depends on bundle size — 5min target OK for 50GB if we stream packaging to S3.

ana: launch criteria checklist (for Phase 1 export):
- export API + UI
- per-tenant retention config (90/365/custom)
- audit schema + docs
- acceptance test with customer (export + restore)
- monitoring + cost estimate

If all green -> ship beta.

kevin: also add: key access logs must be included in evidence pack; link to compliance matrix.

maria: Linda is OK with export first; BYOK is a gating enterprise ask but they can wait for Q4. They want demo by mid-Q3.

sam: action items:
- @sam: spike export streaming approach (ETA Wed)
- @eng-platform: perf estimate for indexing (ETA next Tue)
- @ana: update PRD with acceptance criteria + runbook (ETA Fri)

linda (customer): thanks everyone — confirm we can test with a 10GB export sample next week.

ops-bot: Deployed export-service branch: feature/export-streaming -> staging

ana: ok align — moving Phase 1 to Q2 beta, Phase 2 (search) Q3, BYOK target Q4. Will surface to roadmap.

maria: Thanks. I'll close loop with Linda and capture commercial ask.

sam: putting spike in sprint backlog.

kevin: I'll draft KMS requirements doc.

maria: :thumbsup:
